Name: Stardew Pool Club
Author: tangsuanz
Description:

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757018-455059393.png[/img][/center]

[i]This mod is a small present for my wife. She loves billiards, so I built it around the pool table in the Stardrop Saloon. While I was at it — I had made her a kite-flying mod earlier as well; it plays nicely, and it is a lot of fun. That one is called  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20574]Stardew Kite Soar[/url].[/i]

— tangsuan

Stardew Pool Club is an eight-ball add-on for Stardew Valley. The pool table in the Saloon stops being decoration: fifteen balls, a cue, automatic foul detection, and a physics simulation that moves every ball with spin and friction, so a shot feels like a shot. Every season there is a tournament, and on the Fridays without one there is an exhibition. The whole town keeps tabs on how well you play — sooner or later everyone wants to know who the best cue in Stardew Valley is. 

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757131-1823027550.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI[/b] 4.1.0 or newer.[/*]
[*][b]StardewUI[/b] 0.6.1 or newer — draws everything that is not the table itself.[/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher[/b] 2.0.0 or newer — the furniture, the events and the letters.[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] — optional, install it only if you want to change settings from inside the game.[/*]
[/list]
Unzip the download into your Mods folder and run the game once.

Folders be like:
[spoiler]
[quote][font=Courier New]Mods/
  Stardew Pool Club /
    Pool/          Stardew Pool Club
    [CP] Pool/    Stardew Pool Club Content[/font][/quote]Both folders have to stay inside the same Pool folder. If SMAPI reports a broken content pack, that nesting is the first thing to check.[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757259-724988696.png[/img][/center]

Aim with the mouse, hold to charge, release to shoot. The balls then move under a real physics simulation, with spin and friction.

[b]Eight-ball rules[/b]

[list]
[*]1–7 are solids, 9–15 are stripes. The goal is to pot your whole group first, then the eight ball.[/*]
[*]A ball potted on the break does not assign a group: whichever type you pot on your first real shot is your group for the rest of the frame.[/*]
[*]Potting the eight on the break does not win. It goes back on the table and you keep shooting.[/*]
[*]Pot the eight before your group is cleared and you lose the frame on the spot.[/*]
[*]Once your group is gone, the eight is the target. Scratch on the shot that pots it and you still lose the frame.[/*]
[*]Common fouls: scratch, hitting your opponent's ball first, hitting nothing at all. A foul passes the turn and hands your opponent ball in hand — the cue ball can go anywhere on the table.[/*]
[*]A frame is worth friendship either way, win or lose.[/*]
[/list]
Every villager runs the same engine with a different set of numbers: how big a cut they will take, how far ahead they plan position, how willingly they defend, how much their aim wanders, how often they use spin. Sebastian is working out the next shot. Alex is breaking the rack open.

[b]Gamepad Support[/b]

[b]AI Player Styles:[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Power hitter[/b] — takes thin cuts, barely thinks about position. Alex.[/*]
[*][b]Position player[/b] — soft hands, every shot sets up the next one. Sebastian, Leah.[/*]
[*][b]Safety player[/b] — would rather tuck the cue ball on the rail and wait for your mistake. Elliott.[/*]
[*][b]Chess player[/b] — plays the whole rack ahead. Maru, the Wizard.[/*]
[*][b]Grinder[/b] — only takes the shots it can make, one point at a time. Harvey, Penny, Caroline.[/*]
[*][b]Feel player[/b] — brilliant pots and absurd misses in the same frame. Shane, Abigail.[/*]
[*][b]Showman[/b] — bank shots, combinations, spin for its own sake; winning has to look good. Sam, Emily.[/*]
[*][b]Scrambler[/b] — may not pot anything, but you will not enjoy it. Ysabelle, from Ridgeside Village.[/*]
[/list]The styles also beat each other: power hitter → grinder → scrambler → position player → safety player → power hitter. That cycle carries ±15% in the tournament simulation. Feel players and showmen sit outside it. There is no best style, and that is on purpose.[/spoiler]

The table starts locked. Get close to Sebastian — one heart — and he is the one who will write to you about it.


Friendship and unlocking:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]A frame is worth 20 points, and winning it is worth 60 more.[/*]
[*]Up to 120 points per villager per day, and four frames with each of them.[/*]
[*]250 points is one heart.[/*]
[*]Sebastian opens the table: at one heart he writes, the letter is in your mailbox the next morning, and you can go and meet him.[/*]
[*]That heart count and the spring fallback day can both be changed in Generic Mod Config Menu, or by hand in config.json.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Controls : 
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]Mouse[/b] — move to aim, left and right arrows fine-tune the angle, hold left-click to charge, release to shoot.[/*]
[*][b]Gamepad[/b] — left stick slides the aim, D-pad fine-tunes, hold A/X to charge, B leaves the table.[/*]
[*][b]Ball in hand[/b] — after a foul, push the cue ball with the mouse or the left stick; the ring turns green where placement is legal, click or A/X to place it.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757287-423584132.png[/img][/center]

Four tournaments a year: spring 19, summer 19, fall 19, and the year-end final on winter 26. Every one of them is a Friday at the Saloon, eight players in two groups — group stage, semi-finals, final, fifteen frames in all.

The champion picks one of three prizes, and reaching the last four pays as well.

The champion's portrait goes up on the Saloon wall and stays there until the next champion takes it down.


Prizes:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Champion, pick one: 3000g, two diamonds, or three prismatic shards.[/*]
[*]Runner-up: 500g. The two losing semi-finalists: 200g each.[/*]
[*]The year-end final doubles all of it.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]


How the bracket works:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Eight players, two groups of four, round robin. Every entrant plays three group frames.[/*]
[*]Group winners and runners-up cross over in the semi-finals, then a single final.[/*]
[*]A tie inside a group is broken by frames won, then by frame difference.[/*]
[*]If a villager cannot make match day, the frame is played without them, silently, so the bracket never stalls.[/*]
[*]A reminder letter reaches you before each tournament.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757304-1462217211.png[/img][/center]

On a Friday with no tournament, the Saloon stays open for pool. From 17:00, two villagers who are actually in the room play an exhibition frame while you watch, and you can put money on it. Afterwards you can challenge the winner: beating them is worth extra friendship on top of what the frame pays anyway. Friday night is atmosphere, not a second league — nothing is ranked and nothing is saved. Come and enjoy it.


Watching and betting:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]The exhibition runs at double speed and can be skipped, but skipping means you watch nothing and bet on nothing.[/*]
[*]Odds come from the two players' simulated win chance, with a 10% margin taken off the top.[/*]
[*]A single bet is capped at 1000g and you get three bets a day.[/*]
[*]The challenge frame carries a stake like any other game.[/*]
[*]Beating the exhibition winner is worth 250 extra points — a full heart.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757317-722023041.png[/img][/center]

Villagers sometimes want something on the frame. The stake is usually an item; gold stakes are a switch in the config and off by default. Win and they hand back a gift, lose and the item is theirs.

Friends at two hearts or more show up in your home phone's contact list. A call puts them at the top of today's invite list, and the frame you play with them that day is worth extra friendship. The same person will not take a second call that soon.

Whatever happens on the table travels. Villagers who were in the room will keep mentioning the result for a few days.


Numbers under the hood:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]A stake is offered on 35% of games, adjustable per villager.[/*]
[*]Winning a staked game is worth 40 extra friendship points, still inside the daily cap.[/*]
[*]One staked game per villager per day. The default gold stake is 500g.[/*]
[*]Keeping a phone appointment is worth 20 points.[/*]
[*]Over 450 lines of dialogue for the table, written by hand in both languages.[/*]
[*]A phone friend will not take a second call for three days.[/*]
[*]Word of a table result lasts three days.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][/center]
Most of it lives in Generic Mod Config Menu — install it and you get seven pages, 44 controls, from AI difficulty to how often villagers talk.

The other twelve live in config.json and are edited by hand: the tournament calendar, the roster, and the stake reward tables.


The twelve that need config.json: 
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]TournamentDates[/b] — the three seasonal tournament days.[/*]
[*][b]GrandFinalDate[/b] — the year-end final, winter 26 by default.[/*]
[*][b]TournamentSize[/b] — entrants per tournament, 8 by default.[/*]
[*][b]TournamentPool[/b] — the candidate roster, filtered to whoever you have installed.[/*]
[*][b]RejectList[/b] — villagers who would rather not play.[/*]
[*][b]FlashyNpcs[/b] — villagers who show off, Sam by default.[/*]
[*][b]AiStyleOverrides[/b] — pin a villager to a particular play style.[/*]
[*][b]GambleChanceOverrides[/b] — stake odds per villager.[/*]
[*][b]GambleRewards[/b] — the gift each villager stakes.[/*]
[*][b]GambleRewardsDefault[/b] — the fallback gift pool.[/*]
[*][b]ChampionPortrait[/b] — whether the champion's portrait goes up on the wall.[/*]
[*][b]TournamentAudience[/b] — pull villagers into the Saloon as spectators on match day; experimental, off by default.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]


[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757374-1045069636.png[/img] [/center]

The tournament roster knows the regulars, and the pool-hungry visitors from Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp, Garden Village and Magic Stardew. Every name is checked when the field is drawn, so you get a line-up your save can actually produce, with no compatibility patches.

If you use a mod that redraws the Saloon interior, check that the table still sits where you expect it.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757479-1148503864.png[/img][/center]

[b]Right-clicking the table does nothing.[/b]
The table is locked until Sebastian's letter arrives: one heart with him, then sleep, then check the mail.

[b]Everyone in the invite list is greyed out.[/b]
Those villagers are not playing today, or you have already played four frames with them. Greyed-out names come back tomorrow.

[b]The villagers are either unbeatable or pushovers.[/b]
Generic Mod Config Menu, then AI difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard, Extreme.

[b]I won the final and got nothing.[/b]
Winning opens a champion screen where you pick one of three prizes. Nothing is posted to you; the pick happens there.

[b]The Friday night event will not start.[/b]
It opens at 17:00, and only on Fridays without a tournament. Before five the door just tells you the Saloon is still empty.

[b]Can I get a pool table of my own?[/b]
Reach the semi-final of any tournament and Gus starts selling one for 3000g.

[size=5][b]星露谷台球俱乐部[/b][/size]

[i]以下为中文说明。[/i]

[i]这个mod，是送给我妻子的小礼物。因为她喜爱台球，我便以星之酒吧的台球桌为原型把它做了出来。顺便一提，之前我还为她做过一款放风筝mod，体验很不错，非常好玩。N网的链接：  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20574]Stardew Kite Soar[/url] [/i]

—— tangsuan

星露谷台球俱乐部是一款以美式八球打法为主的扩展mod。酒吧里的台球桌不再只是装饰，它变成了一张可以真实对战的球桌：有全套的 15 颗球、球杆、自动犯规判定，使用物理引擎模拟台球运动轨迹和碰撞，使击球体验非常真实。
每个季节都会举办一次台球锦标赛，没有比赛的周五晚上还有表演赛，全镇的居民都会留意你的球技水平，来看看谁才是星露谷球王！

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757548-1792691573.png[/img][/center]

前置 MOD
StardewUI 用于非台球桌的 UI 绘制
Content Patcher 用于添加家具心间事件等
GMCM 可选，如果你想在游戏内调整配置的话

目录结构
[spoiler]
[quote][font=Courier New]Mods/
  Stardew Pool Club/
    Pool/          星露谷台球俱乐部
    [CP] Pool/    星露谷台球俱乐部内容包[/font][/quote]两个文件夹必须留在同一个 Pool 文件夹里。如果 SMAPI 提示内容包损坏，先看这层嵌套。[/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757557-353479057.png[/img][/center]

鼠标瞄准，按住蓄力，松手出杆。然后球就会按照真实物理引擎模拟的轨迹运动，带旋转和摩擦。

[b]美式八球规则[/b]

[list]
[*]1–7 号是实色球，9–15 号是花色球。目标：先把自己这一组球全部打进袋，再打进黑 8 获胜。[/*]
[*]开球落袋不算定花色：第一杆正式进球打的是哪一类，接下来就都打这一类。[/*]
[*]开球直接打进黑 8 不算赢，黑 8 拿出来重摆，继续击球。[/*]
[*]自己的球没清完之前打进黑 8，直接判输！[/*]
[*]清完自己所有球之后，黑 8 才算目标球；打进黑 8 时白球跟着落袋，这局同样输掉。[/*]
[*]常见犯规：白球掉袋、白球先碰到对方的球、没碰到任何目标球。犯规就换对手击球，对手拿到手中白球，可以摆在台面任意位置。[/*]
[*]打球能涨对战居民的好感，输赢都可以。[/*]
[/list]
每位村民跑的是同一套引擎，但参数各不相同：敢切多薄的球、走位往后想几杆、愿不愿意防守、瞄准抖多少、多久加一次塞。塞巴斯蒂安在算下一杆，亚历克斯在炸堆。

[b]支持手柄操作[/b]

[b]AI的球风：[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]重炮手[/b]——敢切薄球，几乎不管走位。亚历克斯。[/*]
[*][b]走位大师[/b]——力量细腻，每一杆都在为下一杆铺路。塞巴斯蒂安、莉亚。[/*]
[*][b]安全球专家[/b]——宁可贴库藏母球，等你先失误。艾利欧特。[/*]
[*][b]全局棋手[/b]——当棋下，会规划整组残局。玛鲁、法师。[/*]
[*][b]保守研磨者[/b]——只打有把握的球，一分一分磨。哈维、潘妮、卡洛琳。[/*]
[*][b]直觉派[/b]——神球和离谱失误齐飞。谢恩、阿比盖尔。[/*]
[*][b]表演艺术家[/b]——翻袋、组合球、加塞，要赢得漂亮。山姆、艾米丽。[/*]
[*][b]搅局者[/b]——自己不一定进，先让你难受。伊莎贝尔，来自里奇赛德村。[/*]
[/list]风格之间还相克：重炮手 → 保守研磨者 → 搅局者 → 走位大师 → 安全球专家 → 重炮手。这条循环在锦标赛模拟里带 ±15%。直觉派和表演艺术家不进这个圈。没有最强的球风，这是故意的。[/spoiler]

台球桌一开始是不能使用的。和塞巴斯蒂安熟络到 1 心，他会写信来邀你去打球。


好感与解锁：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]打完一局增加 20 点，赢了再增加 60 点。[/*]
[*]每位村民每天上限 120 点，最多四局。[/*]
[*]250 点是一颗心。[/*]
[*]塞巴斯蒂安与你的关系到 1 心后，他会写信，第二天早上信送到邮箱，你就可以去赴约啦。[/*]
[*]这个心数和春季保底日都能在 GMCM 里改，也能手改 config.json。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]


操作方式：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]鼠标[/b]——移动瞄准，左右方向键微调角度，按住左键蓄力，松开出杆。[/*]
[*][b]手柄[/b]——左摇杆移动瞄准，十字键左右微调，按住 A/X 蓄力，B 离开球桌。[/*]
[*][b]自由球[/b]——犯规后，用鼠标或左摇杆推动白球，圆环变绿表示可以摆在这里，点击或 A/X 落位。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757575-499050187.png[/img][/center]

比赛日期：春季 19 日、夏季 19 日、秋季 19 日，以及冬季 26 日的年终总决赛。全都是周五，在酒吧举行，八名选手分两组，小组赛、半决赛和决赛，共十五场比赛。

冠军可以从三件奖品里挑一件，打进四强也都有奖金。

冠军的肖像会挂到酒吧墙上，接受大家的赞誉，直到下一届冠军诞生。


奖金：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]冠军三选一：3000 金、钻石 2 颗，或万象晶球 3 颗。[/*]
[*]亚军 500 金，止步四强的两人各 200 金。[/*]
[*]年终总决赛奖金翻倍。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

赛制细则：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]八名选手分两组，每组四人打循环，每人三场小组赛。[/*]
[*]各组前两名交叉进半决赛，然后是一场决赛。[/*]
[*]小组内同胜场时先比胜局数，再比净胜局。[/*]
[*]如果某位村民当天来不了，这一场会静默地按缺席处理，赛程不会卡住。[/*]
[*]每届比赛前都会收到提醒信。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757587-282689810.png[/img][/center]

没有锦标赛的周五，酒吧照常为台球开着。17:00 起，当晚真的站在酒吧里的两名村民会打一场表演赛，你可以看，也可以押注。
表演赛结束之后，你可以挑战赢家。赢下挑战赛，除了这局本来的好感点数，还会多给你一些好感奖励。
周五之夜的表演赛是气氛场，不算排名，不是比赛。大家high起来吧！！！

观赛与下注：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]表演赛按两倍速进行，可以跳过，但跳过了就既看不到也押不了。[/*]
[*]赔率来自两位选手的模拟胜率，结算时抽 10% 水。[/*]
[*]单注上限 1000 金，每天三笔。[/*]
[*]挑战赛和普通对局一样可以带赌注。[/*]
[*]赢下挑战赛额外 250 点好感，也就是一颗心。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757598-1692057477.png[/img][/center]

村民有时想在这局上押点东西。赌注通常是物品（配置里可以打开村民金币赌注的开关）。你赢了，他回你一份礼；你输了，东西归他。

好感 2 心以上的朋友会出现在你家里电话的联系人列表里。打过电话，他当天会排在邀请名单最前面，而且当天和他打的那局有额外好感。同一个人，短期内不会接第二通。

球赛的消息藏不住！到场观战的村民，之后数日都会谈起这场精彩的对局。

一些具体的设定：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]35% 的对局会触发赌注，可以按村民单独调。[/*]
[*]赌注局赢了额外 40 点好感，仍受每日上限约束。[/*]
[*]每位村民每天一局赌注，默认金币注 500 金。[/*]
[*]电话约的局按时赴约，额外 20 点好感。[/*]
[*]450 句以上的对局台词，中英双语都是手写。[/*]
[*]同一个人，短期内不会接第二通。[/*]
[*]闲话持续三天。[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757611-360941498.png[/img][/center]

大部分设置在 Generic Mod Config Menu 里：装上它就有七个分区，44 个控件，从 AI 难度到村民说话频率都有。

剩下十二项在 config.json 里，只能手改——赛历、名单，以及赌注的奖励表。


需要手改 config.json 的十二项配置：
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]TournamentDates[/b]——三届季节赛的日期。[/*]
[*][b]GrandFinalDate[/b]——年终总决赛，默认冬季 26 日。[/*]
[*][b]TournamentSize[/b]——每届参赛人数，默认 8 人。[/*]
[*][b]TournamentPool[/b]——候选名单，按你实际安装的 mod 过滤。[/*]
[*][b]RejectList[/b]——今天不想打台球的人。[/*]
[*][b]FlashyNpcs[/b]——爱炫技的村民，默认山姆。[/*]
[*][b]AiStyleOverrides[/b]——把某位村民固定成某种球风。[/*]
[*][b]GambleChanceOverrides[/b]——按村民调整赌注触发概率。[/*]
[*][b]GambleRewards[/b]——每位村民押什么。[/*]
[*][b]GambleRewardsDefault[/b]——兜底回礼池。[/*]
[*][b]ChampionPortrait[/b]——冠军肖像要不要挂墙。[/*]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54453/54453-1792757639-665561383.png[/img][/center]

锦标赛名单认得原版常客，也认得星露谷扩展、里奇赛德村、东斯卡普、花园村与魔法·艾依莎里那些球瘾不小的访客。报名时会逐个校验，所以你拿到的是自己存档真能凑出来的阵容，不需要兼容补丁。

如果你装了重绘酒吧内部的 mod，请确认球桌还在原来的位置。

[center][/center]

[b]右键球桌没反应。[/b]
桌子要等塞巴斯蒂安的信：和他到 1 心，睡一觉，第二天看邮箱。

[b]邀请名单里的人全是灰的。[/b]
他们今天不想打，或者你已经和他打满四局了。灰掉的名字明天会回来。

[b]村民要么打不过，要么太弱。[/b]
打开 Generic Mod Config Menu，在 AI 难度里选：简单、普通、困难、极限。

[b]我赢了决赛，但什么都没拿到。[/b]
夺冠后会弹出领奖界面，三种奖品选一种。奖励不会寄给你，要在这里选。

[b]周五之夜点不进去。[/b]
它 17:00 才开，而且只在没有锦标赛的周五。五点之前点，只会提示你酒吧还没人。

[b]我自己家里能摆一张吗？[/b]
任意一届锦标赛打进四强，格斯就会开始卖，3000 金一张。
